Adapted: SUBAGENT_FINISHED s1 inserted before RUN_FINISHED, since verification rejects RUN_FINISHED with s1 active; it closes s1's lane (END m1 lands before it) so the TS assertion that the last three events are END m1, END p1, RUN_FINISHED becomes END m1, SUBAGENT_FINISHED, END p1, RUN_FINISHED.
